{{Top|leg}}
'''Lumalamps''' were illumination devices. [[Exovar's Emporium]] used lumalamps shaped like [[Candle/Legends|candles]] to create a cozy atmosphere. Lumalamps could also be carried by individuals as portable light sources.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
